title: Refine ticket acceptance wording
summary: Make evidence explicit while retaining the time-boxed feasibility scope.

sections.label: Existing coverage
sections.text: The supplied study scope already requires process documentation, constraints, effort and cost, API shape and a go/no-go recommendation. The refinements below make evidence more explicit within that scope.

sections.label: Paste-ready refinement
sections.text: The feasibility report includes representative input/output examples with agreed usability criteria, evidence of current engineer-assisted effort and required interventions, and an initial evaluation of the proposed approach. It distinguishes measured results from estimates, documents incomplete/unsupported-input behaviour and the generation/application boundary, and provides a go, conditional-go or no-go recommendation with explicit assumptions, owners and a costed next phase.

sections.label: Supporting detail
items: Reuse checked cases and execution evidence.
State access and operating ownership constraints.
Experiment to resolve a material assumption.
Document coverage limits and unknown benefits.

sections.label: Complementary contribution
sections.text: Define representative examples, behavior, checks and comparison evidence alongside the hosting and integration study. Agree ownership within the team. These are suggested study activities.

sections.label: Evidence basis
sections.text: Adapted from supplied study material. Internal ticket identifiers are omitted. The wording and division of work are recommendations, not observed workplace outcomes.

basis: Ticket-scoped recommendation; not an implemented workplace capability
confidence: Moderate for fit; workplace benefit unknown

catalog.applicability: Illustrative context. Compare its assumptions with your own work.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
